title: Suspension-sentinel tooling-limitation adjudication of G5A-M01 (36 identities)

cohort.name: G5A-M01
cohort.mechanism: coroutine suspension sentinel: the mutated instruction is the result != COROUTINE_SUSPENDED comparison immediately following a child suspend call

campaign1.role: frozen discovery measurement (source of the 36 raw statuses)
campaign1.measuredCommitCorrection: 5856530e is the stale committed population's historical measuredCommit, not the discovery campaign commit

campaign2.configDiff: family-list narrowing only: 53 deletions in config/quality/test-quality.yml, the approval family block untouched
rejectedArtifacts: attempt-2 malformed security report (Content is not allowed in trailing section) caused by two PIT runs sharing one report root
a copied mutation-baseline.json that was byte-identical to the committed baseline and therefore not a campaign-2 artifact

layers: canonical generated population (identity-equality asserted for every member)
raw PIT report (independent status agreement for all 36)

numberOfTestsRunNote: numberOfTestsRun='0' is an XML ATTRIBUTE on <mutation> and is present on every TIMED_OUT mutation (70/70 discovery, 62/62 approval family in this campaign), as on all 190 NO_COVERAGE mutations. The frozen manifest's 0 is PIT's own measurement. An earlier revision of this manifest wrongly stated the attribute was absent; superseded, not erased.

adjudication.note: TOOLING_LIMITATION is not EQUIVALENT and not KILLED. PIT cannot execute or measure these mutations normally, so the result carries no information about authored test adequacy.

parentAccounting.excluded: the 16 already-adjudicated identities of the 68-row P1 manifest are not part of the frozen G5 52 and are not counted here
